course.title: Power Electronics

content.value: An SCR half-wave rectifier has a forward breakdown voltage of 150V when a gate current of 1 mA flows in the gate circuit. It a sinusoidal voltage of 400 V peak is applied, find: (i) firing angle, (ii) average output voltage, (iii) average current for a load resistance of 200 Ω, and (iv) power output.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
